description: Create NPC mnemons (individual people). role is an optional free-text role or occupation. Use affiliationEntryIds to name the factions each NPC belongs to; the server projects them into MEMBER relationships. For a faction, guild or cult use create_faction_mnemons. Players may not call this — GM/co-GM only.

affiliationEntryIds.description: Factions this person belongs to (Faction entryIds or titles).

markdown.description: Body content as Markdown. Mentions: @[label](mnemon:<entryId>). Images: ![caption](asset:<assetId>@<campaignId>) — upload the asset first.

primaryLocationEntryId.description: Home location — entryId or exact title.

role.description: Free-text role or occupation, e.g. "innkeeper", "captain of the guard".

name: create_npc_mnemons
title: Create NPC mnemons
